description: Either takes an export with one row per invoice (amount, PO number, invoice, PO, requisition, approval, due and payment dates, exception yes/no, cash discount available and taken) and calculates PO coverage by spend, share of invoices without a PO, after-the-fact POs, requisition-to-PO and invoice-to-approval cycle times (median), invoice exceptions and first-time match, payment on time and cash discount captured with the amount left on the table; or takes finished figures (kpi, actual, target) and rates them. Every figure gets red, amber or green against a target (the user's own or a stated suggestion; amber within 20 percent of the target) and the base it was calculated on. Fields that are missing are named instead of guessed. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

kpis.description: Alternative to rows: finished figures with kpi, actual, target, optional better (higher or lower), unit, owner.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Invoice rows: amount, po (number or empty), invoice_date, po_date, pr_date, approved_date, due_date, paid_date, exception (yes/no), discount_available (amount), discount_taken (amount or yes/no).

targets.description: Own targets for the calculated figures, keys po_coverage, no_po_share, after_the_fact, pr_to_po_days, exceptions, first_time_match, invoice_to_approval_days, on_time_payment, discount_capture.

name: check_kpis
title: Check source-to-pay KPIs as a traffic light: PO coverage, invoices without PO, after-the-fact POs, cycle times, exceptions, payment on time, cash discount
